content.short: Zealy is a Web3 community growth platform that helps projects build loyal communities through quest-based engagement and reward programs.
content.description: Zealy is a community engagement platform used by Web3 projects to create quests, reward contributors, and grow loyal user bases through structured sprint campaigns. Projects design on-chain and off-chain tasks, and community members earn XP and token rewards for completing them. Zealy has become the de facto tool for Mantle ecosystem projects launching new protocols, with its gamified approach to community building driving measurable growth in user acquisition and retention.
content.meta: Zealy is a Web3 community growth platform powering loyalty and engagement for Mantle ecosystem projects. Discover Zealy on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
